newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Sept cumulative PSBR 95.861 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy Sept cumulative PSBR 95.861 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was 95.861 trillion lire at end-September 1996 compared with 92.937 trillion in end September 1995, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement.

It added that Treasury management operations showed a provisional net deficit of around 11.165 trillion lire in September. The Treasury has already released a provisional public sector borrowing requirement figure of 116.300 trillion lire for the Janurary-October period.
Receipts totalled 374.004 trillion lire over the January-September period against expenditure of 458.700 trillion.
Medium- and long-term domestic borrowing over the period raised 98.812 trillion, while 10.010 trillion was raised on international markets.
The volume of short-term Treasury bills in circulation fell 12.703 trillion lire to 399.311 trillion at end-September from 412.014 trillion at end-December 1995.
